idea-plugin.name: Code Story
idea-plugin.description:
Guided code walkthroughs from your AI coding agent. Ask the agent for a story, and the IDE plays it step by step: each step opens its file, highlights the code that it explains and shows a short comment in a card beside the code.

  • Stories for different tasks. Ask for the main change of a ticket, how a flow works, how a bug can occur, or a review handoff for your branch.
  • Read at your own speed. Go to the next or previous step from the card, the Code Story tool window or the keyboard. The card does not take the keyboard focus, so you can continue to work in the editor.
  • Steps follow the code. Steps stay on their code while you edit, and show when their code changed or is gone.
  • See what changed. In a story about a change, steps show A for new code and M for changed code, and Show diff compares the file with the base commit.
  • Share stories with your branch. A shared story is a file in .codestory/shared/ that you commit with your code.
  • Ask questions in the story. Post a question or a change request on a step, and a listening agent answers in the story.

Code Story works with Claude Code, Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot in Rider and GitHub Copilot CLI. The agent sends stories through the IDE's MCP server, or writes a story file when the server is off. The plugin installs the agent skill and checks your setup. It makes no network calls and sends no telemetry.

To start, follow Set up your agent. Report problems and ideas in the issue tracker.
